import warnings
from astropy.io import fits

# Header.fromstring with bytes
h = fits.Header.fromstring(b'SIMPLE  =                    T')
print('Header.fromstring bytes:', repr(h['SIMPLE']))
assert h['SIMPLE'] is True

# with sep
h2 = fits.Header.fromstring(b'UNDEF   = \nDEFINED = 42', sep='\n')
print('sep bytes:', repr(h2['UNDEF']), repr(h2['DEFINED']))
assert h2['UNDEF'] is None and h2['DEFINED'] == 42

# Card.fromstring with bytes
c = fits.Card.fromstring(b'ABC     = F')
print('Card.fromstring bytes:', repr(c.value), repr(str(c)))
assert c.value is False
assert str(c) == 'ABC     = F'.ljust(80)

# str still works
c2 = fits.Card.fromstring('ABC     = F')
assert c2.value is False
h3 = fits.Header.fromstring('SIMPLE  =                    T')
assert h3['SIMPLE'] is True

# non-ASCII bytes -> replaced like file reading
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
    warnings.simplefilter('always')
    c3 = fits.Card.fromstring(u'BÀR'.encode('latin1'))
    print('non-ascii card:', repr(c3.keyword), 'warnings:', [str(x.message) for x in w])
print('ALL OK')
"
